verdict.rationale: Unit's docs confirm accounts are held in FBO (for-benefit-of) structures and that the Dashboard/APIs expose account, compliance, and transaction data, giving some transparency into fund structure and ledger access. However, there is no explicit documentation of how/where FDIC insurance attaches (pass-through insurance mechanics), nor any detail on ledger permissioning or who specifically can view balances at the bank-partner level. Missing for 10: explicit FDIC pass-through insurance disclosure, detailed ledger access/permission documentation, and independent confirmation of these claims.
